\"\"\"LOO cross-validation in log1p space.\"\"\"
import sys
import numpy as np
import scanpy as sc
from sklearn.preprocessing import MaxAbsScaler
from scipy.stats import pearsonr
import importlib.util

def load_method(path):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('m', path)
    mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
    return mod

def loo_mse(method_path, train_path):
    train = sc.read_h5ad(train_path)
    cell_types = sorted(train.obs['cell_type'].unique())
    fold_mses = []
    for target_ct in cell_types:
        train_mask = train.obs['cell_type'] "'!= target_ct
        target_ctrl_mask = (train.obs['"'cell_type'] == target_ct) & (train.obs['condition'] == 'control')
        target_stim_mask = (train.obs['cell_type'] == target_ct) & (train.obs['condition'] == 'stimulated')
        train_adata = train[train_mask].copy()
        target_ctrl_adata = train[target_ctrl_mask].copy()
        target_stim_adata = train[target_stim_mask].copy()
        scaler = MaxAbsScaler()
        train_adata.X = scaler.fit_transform(train_adata.X)
        target_ctrl_adata.X = scaler.transform(target_ctrl_adata.X)
        mod = load_method(method_path)
        model = mod.build_model(train_adata, 'cpu', 42)
        mod.train_model(model, 42)
        pred = mod.predict(model, target_ctrl_adata, scaler, 42 + 10000)
        pred = np.asarray(pred, dtype=np.float64)
        truth = target_stim_adata.X
        if hasattr(truth, 'toarray'):
            truth = truth.toarray()
        truth = np.asarray(truth, dtype=np.float64)
        true_mean = truth.mean(axis=0)
        pred_mean = pred.mean(axis=0)
        mse = np.mean((true_mean - pred_mean) ** 2)
        fold_mses.append(mse)
        print(f\"  {target_ct}: MSE={mse:.6f}\")
    avg = np.mean(fold_mses)
    print(f\"Avg LOO MSE: {avg:.6f}\")
    return avg

if __name__ == '__main__':
    p = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else '/workspace/solution/method.py'
    loo_mse(p, '/workspace/public_assets/train.h5ad')
